name: look
description: Zen mode hides tool noise while Claude works, and skins give each project its own color palette through a Claude Code theme of its own. Plain code: no model calls.

zen.title: Zen
zen.description: Hide tool calls and their output in the transcript; prompts, answers and the progress band stay.

zenErrors.title: Zen keeps failures
zenErrors.description: Under Zen, still show a tool call that failed.

skins.title: Skins
skins.description: Pick a color skin for a project with /skin. A project keeps its skin; switching this off in a session turns it plain.

skinsAuto.title: Skins for new projects
skinsAuto.description: The first time a session starts in a project, give it a skin picked from its name. It writes a theme line to the project's .claude/settings.local.json.
